questions.stem:
Choose the word that best fills the blank.

The committee's statement was so ______ that even its own members disagreed about what it meant.
Which of the following sentences is grammatically correct?
options: Neither the manager nor the clerks was present.
Neither the manager nor the clerks were present.
Neither the manager or the clerks were present.
Neither of the manager nor the clerks were present.

questions.stem: A shopkeeper marks an article 25% above its cost price and then sells it at a discount of 12% on the marked price. The profit, as a percentage of the cost price, is ______ (as an integer).
What is the next number in the series 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ___ ?
Which of the following numbers are divisible by **both** 3 and 4?

The table shows the number of units of three products P, Q and R sold by a shop in the four quarters of a year.

| Quarter | P | Q | R |
|---|---|---|---|
| Quarter 1 | 120 | 80 | 50 |
| Quarter 2 | 150 | 90 | 60 |
| Quarter 3 | 135 | 110 | 55 |
| Quarter 4 | 180 | 100 | 70 |

In which quarter was the share of product Q in that quarter's total sales the highest?

Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 12 hours and 18 hours respectively. Pipe C can empty the full tank in 36 hours. If all three pipes are opened together on an empty tank, the tank is full in ______ hours (as an integer).

Four friends P, Q, R and S sit in a row, all facing north.

- Q is not at either end.
- R sits immediately to the right of P.
- S sits at the right end.

Who sits at the left end?

**Statements:** All P are Q. All Q are R. Some R are not S.

Assume that none of P, Q, R and S is empty. Which of the following conclusions follow **necessarily** from the statements?
If $\log_2 x + \log_4 x = 6$, then the value of $x$ is ______ (as an integer).
The eigenvalues of the matrix $A = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 \end{pmatrix}$ are
The maximum number of nodes in a binary tree of height 4 is ______. (A tree with only a root has height 0.)
Which of the following sorting algorithms run in $O(n \log n)$ time in the **worst** case on an array of $n$ elements?
options: Quicksort that always picks the last element as the pivot

questions.stem: The 8-bit two's complement number $11110110$ has the decimal value ______.
The DFA below works over the alphabet $\{0, 1\}$. The arrow marks the start state $q_0$, and $q_0$ (double circle) is the only accepting state. Which language does it accept?
options: Strings with an even number of 0s
Strings with an odd number of 1s
Strings with an even number of 1s

questions.stem:
Four processes arrive as shown (times in milliseconds).

| Process | Arrival time | Burst time |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | 0 | 7 |
| P2 | 2 | 4 |
| P3 | 4 | 1 |
| P4 | 5 | 4 |

They are scheduled by **non-preemptive** shortest job first; a tie in burst time goes to the earlier arrival. Taking waiting time = completion time − arrival time − burst time, the average waiting time in milliseconds is ______ (rounded off to two decimal places).
Which of the following statements about TCP are true?
options: It delivers a reliable, in-order byte stream.
It preserves the boundaries between the messages an application sends.
A connection is set up with a three-way handshake.
Flow control uses the window size advertised by the receiver.

questions.stem: A relation $R(A, B, C, D)$ has the functional dependencies $A \to B$, $B \to C$ and $C \to A$, and only those that follow from them. How many candidate keys does $R$ have?
A fair six-sided die is rolled twice. The probability that the sum of the two numbers is 8 is ______ (rounded off to three decimal places).
